10 cores. CPU-to-wall ratio for the full suite is 34.5s/15.8s = 2.2x.

Essentially all of the suite's CPU is child-process execution: 34.3s measured inside spawnSync against ~34.5s of total user+sys. The test bodies themselves, the assertion work and the node --test harness are collectively noise at this scale.

About a third of the child time is paid before any DoFlow work happens: 252 spawns at a 47.5ms interpreter-plus-require floor is 12.0s of the 34.3s. The remainder is real work, dominated by installs that materialize roughly 204 files apiece at 218ms.

Wall time is set by one file, not by total work: node --test parallelizes across files but runs tests within a file serially, so cli-e2e.test.js's 14.5s of blocked spawn time is the floor and the whole 34.3s of child work completes in 15.8s around it.
